Title: Efficiently Finding the Greatest Common Divisor (GCD)

Steps:
1. Define the Euclidean algorithm function.
2. Ensure inputs are integers and greater than 0.
3. Use recursion or iteration based on preference.
4. Apply the algorithm by repeatedly replacing the larger number with the remainder of the division.
5. Continue until the remainder is 0; the last non-zero remainder is the GCD.
6. Optimize by using modular arithmetic where applicable.
